title: Rabbi Berekhyah bar Chiyya HaKohen
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tanchuma, Chayei Sarah 6, speaking in his father’s name, and in Pesikta deRav Kahana, beginning of piska “UlKachtem.” In Vayikra Rabbah, beginning of chapter 30: Rabbi Berekhyah and his father Rabbi Chiyya in the name of Rabbi Yose ben Nehorai.
Yuchasin cites Rabbi Berekhyah bar Chama HaKohen; Hyman proposes bar Chiyya HaKohen and explains the difference as two yods becoming a mem.

notes.text: The proposed two-yods-to-mem explanation is Hyman’s account of the variant. The digital witnesses do not independently prove the physical letter history.
